Class SwordFiles

java.lang.Object
dev.swordai.client.SwordFiles

    • rewindToStage

      static Path rewindToStage(int stageIndex) throws IOException
      Puts the run back to the moment a stage began: the network as it was when the stage before it was passed, and the history up to there. Everything replaced is first copied to a backup folder, which is returned.
      Parameters:
      stageIndex - the stage to start again, counted from 0; must be 1 or more
      Throws:
      IOException

    • keepBeforeHeadless

      static void keepBeforeHeadless() throws IOException
      Keeps a copy of everything learned so far, replacing the copy kept before. Called when training without the screen takes over from training on it, so that one command brings back the network the screen trained if the other kind turns out worse.
      Throws:
      IOException

    • keepBeforePromotion

      static void keepBeforePromotion() throws IOException
      Keeps everything learned so far before the copy that learned from fights against people takes the proven network's place, so that /swordai undo brings back the one it replaced.
      Throws:
      IOException

    • keepBeforePeople

      static boolean keepBeforePeople(List<dev.swordai.core.report.UpdateRecord> history, Consumer<String> say)
      Called when a fight or a sparring match that is learned from begins. If the run's last update was not already one of those, everything learned so far is kept, so that /swordai undo brings back the network from before people had a hand in it.
      Parameters:
      say - told when the copy could not be made
      Returns:
      whether a copy was kept just now

    • kept

      private static boolean kept(Path keep)

    • newestKept

      static Path newestKept()
      The copy /swordai undo goes back to: whichever of the two was kept last, or null when neither is there.

    • restoreKept

      static Path restoreKept(Path keep) throws IOException
      Puts the run back to what was kept in keep. What it replaces is moved to a backup folder first, which is returned, and so is the kept copy itself: an undo is used up, and the next one goes back to whatever was kept before it.
      Throws:
      IOException

    • archiveRun

      static Path archiveRun() throws IOException

      IOException
